about: Every publication this project prepares, and where each one stands. docs/PUBLISHING-PAPERS.md explains the steps and the statuses; node tools/paper-check.js checks each entry against its files, and allows no email address in a paper's files except author.email. Update this file in the pull request that changes a status.

papers.title: Minimal Winding in the Self-Similar Collapse of Point Vortices
papers.note: Ready for arXiv: the code DOI of release v2.0.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22963796, is in its data availability paragraph (papers/minimal-winding/submission/CHECKLIST.md). By the owner's decision (2026-09-25) the alpha-model draft (formerly alpha-winding) is merged into this paper, which also carries the computer-assisted proofs for four or more vortices; the title changed with the merge. Release v1.0.0 of the companion is archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22953035 (2026-09-25, before the central-vortex result and the merge); the paper cites the version DOI of v2.0.0.

papers.title: Point-Vortex Collapse Without Rotation: A Cluster Mechanism, a Phase Diagram and a Continuum Limit
papers.note: Drafted in this repository by the owner's decision (2026-09-25), with the registry's author block as for minimal-winding, which it cites as its companion paper. Before 'preparing': read O'Neil, Theor. Comput. Fluid Dyn. 24 (2010) 39-44 (the continuum section makes no claim of priority until then; a TODO in the LaTeX source marks it), and a second reader. The public companion repository does not exist yet.

papers.title: Closed forms and sharp minima of ω t_c on three classical point-vortex collapse families
papers.note: Zero confirmed novel findings; a Zenodo record of its own is planned (identities/README.md), not a journal submission. Its links into this repository must be replaced before the record, since this repository may be private.

papers.title: GENChase: seeded scientific simulations with validation records, provenance and print export
papers.note: Journal of Open Source Software draft; JOSS needs the software DOI from Zenodo before acceptance (docs/PUBLISHING.md, section 4).
